Elaine M.: Heads up — Acme wants to validate an on-prem POC in their sealed network next week. Main asks: image signing, delta updates, and upgrade cadence. Can we confirm constraints and a recommended runbook?

Javier R.: Short answer: we can support signed delta bundles + full image. Typical cadence customers want is monthly patches + urgent security backports.

Mike T.: For sealed networks the big hurdles are: (1) how operator pulls bundles (airgap transfer medium), (2) cert rotation for mTLS between components, (3) rollback plan.

Sara L.: They asked whether we provide a signed bundle artifact they can import offline, or if they need our SRE to do the install on-prem. Their security team insists on bringing images in via USB and verifying sigs.

Javier R.: We can produce a signed tar.gz containing metadata.json (sha256 checksums + signed manifest) and a detached signature. Example verify cmd we give to customers: 

  openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pubkey.pem -signature manifest.sig manifest.json

Mike T.: Also provide a small verification helper binary (static) so their ops don't need to pull openssl. That binary does: verify manifest -> validate checksums -> run preflight.sh.

Elaine M.: Licensing / pricing question from AE: will this count as "on-prem private" (enterprise tier) or is it treated as Hosted with airgap delivery fee? Need billing stance before we promise no-cost installs.

Sara L.: Sales: they expect the POC to be free but may sign for Dedicated if perf checks out. Recommend we offer a 30-day free POC with a one-time offline-delivery fee to cover engineering packaging and signing.

Legal Bot: Reminder: for offline image delivery we must include SBOM and a signed acknowledgement of accepted support limits. Also include export controls check.

Javier R.: Upgrade cadence/compat: our runtime supports forward-compatible deltas for minor releases (x.y -> x.y+1). Major upgrades (x -> x+1) require operator-assisted schema migrations and a small downtime window. Recommend: monthly minor deltas + quarterly majors unless customer opts out.

Mike T.: Rollout runbook sketch: 
- We deliver signed bundle + SBOM + install-runbook.pdf
- Customer imports via USB or internal registry.
- They run: 
  ./redwood-install verify --manifest manifest.json --sig manifest.sig 
  ./redwood-install apply --bundle bundle.tar.gz --mode offline
- Post-install healthcheck hits local /health and returns OK before traffic switch.

Elaine M.: Ops ask: certificate rotation — can we support customer-owned CA for mTLS?

Javier R.: Yes. We support customer-provided certs and have a cert-rotation job that can run offline. We provide instructions to generate CSRs and how to apply new cert bundles. If they want HSM signing we support PKCS#11 flows (requires extra config).

Sara L.: Action items: (1) Javier: produce sample signed bundle + verification helper by Fri (2) Mike: draft POC runbook + rollback steps (3) Legal: draft the offline-delivery addendum and SBOM checklist.

Elaine M.: I'll brief AE and set expectation: 30-day free POC, one-time delivery fee if they want our engineering to assist.

OpsBot: CI artifact job created: artifactory/offline-bundles/job/271 - produces manifest.json + manifest.sig. Next run scheduled Thu 09:00 UTC.

Mike T.: One more note — we should document the maximum bundle size and recommended delta strategy (rsync-friendly chunks). Customer has limited USB capacity (16GB). Keep deltas small.

Elaine M.: Great, thanks all. I'll loop Legal + AE on this thread for signoff. :thumbsup:
